notablePrerequisites: Leyline Immersion attached to any legendary creature you control without summoning sickness.
description:
Activate the legendary creature with Leyline Immersion attached by tapping it, adding {3}{G}{G} that can only be spent to cast spells.
Cast Instill Energy by paying {G}, targeting the legendary creature.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Leyline Immersion to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve Instill Energy, attaching it to the legendary creature.
Activate Instill Energy by paying {0}, untapping the legendary creature.
Cast Leyline Immersion by paying {3}{G}, targeting the legendary creature.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Instill Energy to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve Leyline Immersion, attaching it to the legendary creature.
